name: magpie

attributes.attribute: a symbolic bird in Ireland, an ill omen when met at the start of a journey
four magpies in a row foretold a death in the family

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The magpie was a symbolic bird in Ireland. People saw it as an ill omen to meet a magpie when setting out on a journey. A speckled horse, or magpie pony, was almost as unlucky. Four magpies in a row foretold a death in the family.

okr.objective: Document the magpie as a bird of ill omen in Irish folklore.
key_results: Record the magpie as an ill omen on setting out.
Record the death omen of four magpies in a row.
